updates.title: Two new cheat codes: Move Time Forward and Pinhole
updates.text: Added the D-pad codes for Move Time Forward and Pinhole. Each appears with the identical sequence on at least two independent GTA sites, which brings the total to 23 of 61. Several large outlets still list both as unknown. The other 21 codes were re-checked the same day against about 30 pages and still match. One outlet prints a different Vehicle Force sequence, but more than 20 others agree with the code shown here, so it stays as listed.

updates.title: New guide: Randy's Wish List cars and where to find them
updates.text: Added a guide to the 20 cars Randy wants. It lists only the locations that at least two guides agree on, and says so wherever sources differ.

updates.title: Correction: Randy's Wish List has 20 cars
updates.text: The Randy's Wish List guide said the list was reported to contain 18 cars. The two most detailed car lists now published name the same 20, so the guide has been updated. Separately, guides disagree on how Cycle Weather unlocks: most say finishing the story, a few say revealing the whole map. The cheat page now says that sources differ.

updates.title: Quick answers added to ten guides
updates.text: The most visited guides now open with a short answer, including store robberies, jewelry stores, Randy's Wish List, gun shops, keeping cars and money, the Criminal Profile and making money. Page titles now match what players search for. No facts changed.

updates.title: New guide: GTA 6 patch notes and update tracker
updates.text: Added a page that tracks every GTA 6 update. It starts with update 01.002.002 from 23 November 2026 and the seven fixes in the notes, including autosave, weather and wanted level bugs.

updates.title: Cheat codes re-checked: still 21 of 61
updates.text: All 21 listed codes were re-checked against more than ten outlets and still match. One outlet prints the Cataclysm sequence for Videotape as well, which looks like a copying slip, and several others agree on the Videotape code shown here. No new code met the two-source rule today. One site now lists inputs for the other 40 cheats, but no second independent source shows the same sequences, so they stay marked as not found.

updates.title: Three new cheat codes: Drunk, Videotape and Dark Mirror
updates.text: Added the D-pad codes for Drunk, Videotape and Dark Mirror after several independent sources showed identical sequences. That brings the total to 21 of 61. The 18 earlier codes were re-checked the same day. One wiki lists different inputs for three of them, but at least seven other sources match the codes shown here, so they stay as listed.

updates.title: New guide: GTA 6 editions compared
updates.text: Added a guide to the Standard and Ultimate Editions: prices, the 16 Ultimate bonuses, the Vintage Vice City pre-order pack and why boxed copies have no disc.

updates.title: Privacy policy: Google Analytics
updates.text: The site now uses Google Analytics to measure which pages are useful. The privacy policy explains what is collected, and visitors in the EEA, UK and Switzerland get cookieless measurement by default.

updates.title: Daily fact checks begin
updates.text: From today, cheat codes and guide facts are re-checked every day. New codes are added only when two independent sources show the same sequence, and corrections are logged on this page.

updates.title: 22 new guides: money, vehicles, weapons and basics
updates.text: Added guides on making money in every chapter, selling and keeping cars, garages, the fastest cars, the best weapons, the wanted and Heat system, controls, saving, stats, trophies, side characters and missable content.

updates.title: Correction: Chapter 1 and 2 mission counts
updates.text: Chapter 1 has 22 main missions and Chapter 2 has 11, not 18 and 13 as first listed. Four Chapter 1 missions were added, and two Chapter 2 entries were moved to Billy's optional missions. Mission guides and the Tracker are updated.

updates.title: Tracker: trophies and garages
updates.text: The Tracker now includes the 27 visible trophies and the eight garages you can buy.

updates.title: Six new guides and individual cheat pages
updates.text: Added troubleshooting, fastest-unlock, unlock-order, challenge-track, code-pattern and GTA 5 comparison guides, plus a dedicated page for every verified cheat code.

updates.title: Cheat codes re-verified
updates.text: All 18 listed D-pad codes re-checked against multiple independent launch-week reports. 43 codes are still undiscovered and are marked as such.

updates.title: LeonidaTracker launched
updates.text: Launched with a 100% tracker, all 61 cheats with unlock challenges, four calculators and 30 guides.
